npcs.name: Aling Nena
dialogue: A typhoon is coming! Please help me board my windows.
Find the emergency supplies first, then come back to me.
after_dialogue: Thank you, hijo! Now get to the evacuation center.

mascot.intro: Hi, I'm Tarsi! A typhoon is coming. Check the quest list at the top right. Press H if you need a hint!

quests.supplies: Look for the green go-bag. Every family needs one ready for an emergency.
quests.flashlight: A flashlight is important when the power goes out. Look for the yellow item.
quests.talk_nena: Aling Nena needs help. Walk up to the orange person and press E.
quests.evac: Head to the blue Evacuation Center in the bottom-right corner.
